body.statement:
The polynomial alternative holds, in the following stronger relevant-component form.  Let \(I=(M,a,X,Y,c,L,B)\in\mathfrak M_{\mathrm{exp}}\), and let \(C_X\) and \(C_Y\) be the weak components containing \(X\) and \(Y\) in the underlying undirected full graph of \(G\).  Suppose either that \(C_X\ne C_Y\), or that \(C_X=C_Y=C\) and \(C\) has cycle rank at most one; no restriction is imposed on any other weak component.  Then \(\operatorname{UnicycleHandle}\) is a sound-and-complete polynomial-size certificate calculus and an exact polynomial-time algorithm.  Its value is the causal optimum \(C^\star(I)\), given explicitly as follows.  If \(C_X\ne C_Y\), then \(C^\star(I)=+\infty\).  If \(C_X=C_Y=C\) and \(C\) has cycle rank zero, then
\[
C^\star(I)=
\begin{cases}
+\infty,&X\not\leadsto_{G[C]}Y,\\
\displaystyle
\min_{\substack{s_i\in R(P_i)\setminus\{a_{P_i}\}\\0\le i\le m}}
\sum_{i=1}^{m}C_i(s_{i-1},s_i),
&X\leadsto_{G[C]}Y,
\end{cases}
\]
where \(P_0=X\to\cdots\to P_m=Y\) is the unique directed path in the second case.  If \(C_X=C_Y=C\) and \(C\) has cycle rank one, then
\[
C^\star(I)=\operatorname{MS}_1(I|_C).
\]
In every branch, \(X=a_X\) is a Beckers actual cause of \(Y=a_Y\) if and only if \(C^\star(I)<+\infty\).  The algorithm uses \(O(L^7)\) arithmetic and indexed-address operations overall, every finite rational encountered has \(O(B+\log(L+1))\) bits, and it returns either a Beckers witness with an exact optimum certificate or a polynomial-size weak-component, directed-reachability, or min-sum separating cut.  In particular, the conclusion holds whenever the underlying undirected full graph has exactly one simple cycle.
body.proof_tex:
The stated premise is
\[
C_X\ne C_Y
\quad\text{or}\quad
\bigl(C_X=C_Y=C\text{ and }\operatorname{rank}_{\mathrm{cyc}}(G[C])\le1\bigr). \tag{1}
\]
This is exactly the dispatch premise of \(\texttt{thm:relevant-component-polynomial-frontier}\).

If \(C_X\ne C_Y\), the first branch of \(\texttt{thm:relevant-component-polynomial-frontier}\) applies without any condition on the other components.  It gives both
\[
X=a_X\text{ is not a Beckers actual cause of }Y=a_Y
\quad\text{and}\quad
C^\star(I)=+\infty, \tag{2}
\]
and it certifies (2) by the weak-component partition separating \(X\) from \(Y\).

Suppose next that \(C_X=C_Y=C\).  By (1), the common component has cycle rank zero or one, so the remaining branches of \(\texttt{thm:relevant-component-polynomial-frontier}\) exhaust all cases.  That theorem first proves the exact component-normalization identity
\[
C^\star(I)=C^\star(I|_C), \tag{3}
\]
where an optimum on \(C\) extends with the same cost by retaining every edge and using the actual assignment outside \(C\).  Thus components disjoint from \(C\) require no structural restriction.

When \(C\) has cycle rank zero and \(X\not\leadsto_{G[C]}Y\), the directed-reachability branch of the same theorem gives
\[
C^\star(I|_C)=+\infty. \tag{4}
\]
Together, (3) and (4) give the first rank-zero line in the displayed functional.  The set of vertices reachable from \(X\) contains \(X\), omits \(Y\), and has no directed edge from it to its complement; it is the returned separating cut.  When instead \(X\leadsto_{G[C]}Y\), the underlying tree contains a unique directed path \(P_0=X\to\cdots\to P_m=Y\), and the value-path branch gives
\[
C^\star(I|_C)
=
\min_{\substack{s_i\in R(P_i)\setminus\{a_{P_i}\}\\0\le i\le m}}
\sum_{i=1}^{m}C_i(s_{i-1},s_i). \tag{5}
\]
Substitution of (5) into (3) proves the second rank-zero line.

When \(C\) has cycle rank one, the rank-one branch gives
\[
C^\star(I|_C)=\operatorname{MS}_1(I|_C). \tag{6}
\]
Equations (3) and (6) prove the asserted rank-one formula.  The feasible variables of \(\operatorname{MS}_1\) are the alternate assignment, one support row at every nonintervened endogenous vertex, and the exceptional-edge repair mode specified by \(\operatorname{UnicycleHandle}\); hence (6) is an explicit computable map rather than an existential characterization.

Finally, \(\texttt{thm:relevant-component-polynomial-frontier}\) relates this independently defined minimum-cost functional to the causal query by
\[
\mathbf 1\{X=a_X\text{ is a Beckers actual cause of }Y=a_Y\}
=
\mathbf 1\{C^\star(I)<+\infty\}. \tag{7}
\]
It also supplies \(O(L)\) arithmetic and indexed-address operations in the rank-zero branch, \(O(L^7)\) in the rank-one branch, the bound \(O(B+\log(L+1))\) on every finite rational, and the stated positive or separating certificates.  Taking the maximum of the branch costs gives the advertised \(O(L^7)\) uniform bound.  Equations (2)--(7) therefore prove soundness, completeness, exact optimality, and the full certificate conclusion under (1).

It remains to check that the class asked about in the open question is covered.  Let \(\underline G\) be the underlying undirected graph of a full graph having exactly one simple cycle.  For each connected component \(D\) of \(\underline G\), choose a spanning tree \(T_D\).  Every edge in \(D\setminus T_D\), together with the unique path in \(T_D\) between its endpoints, produces a distinct simple cycle.  There can therefore be at most one such edge in every component, so every component has cycle rank at most one.  Thus either \(C_X\ne C_Y\), or \(C_X=C_Y=C\) with cycle rank at most one, which is precisely (1).  Hence every globally unicyclic full graph is an instance of the stronger result, and the constructive alternative in the open question follows.
